concerns.text: The plan relies on a synthetic fallback dataset because no verified open‑source hydrogen diffusion dataset is available. Using synthetic data does not provide real observations of diffusion coefficients, making the dataset inappropriate for answering the research question about real material behavior.

The pipeline performs 1,000 full nested‑CV refits (including Bayesian hyper‑parameter search) on each bootstrap sample. Even with the 200‑sample synthetic dataset, this exceeds the CI limits (≤ 6 h, ≤ 7 GB RAM) on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner, risking timeout or out‑of‑memory failures. The compute budget is therefore infeasible under the project’s constraints.
